tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.description: Free. Search fetcher.sh's web-data endpoints (Twitter/X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, Google, Google Maps, Google News, Google Play, App Store, Yelp) by keyword and/or service. Returns paths, descriptions and per-call prices. Start here.

tools.name: describe_endpoint
tools.description: Free. Show the full call signature for one endpoint: required and optional parameters, allowed values, price, and response shape.

tools.name: fetch_data
tools.description: Paid. Fetch live data from any fetcher.sh endpoint. Pass the endpoint path plus its parameters (path and query parameters together in `params`). Priced per call in USDC on Base, Monad or Solana: pay with x402, or send an Authorization: Bearer bby_live_... header to spend prepaid credits. Call descri

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Free. Show the remaining credit balance for the API key sent in this connection's Authorization header. Call this before a long run of paid requests.

tools.name: topup_credits
tools.description: Paid (the amount you choose, minimum $1). Buy prepaid credits with x402 so later calls skip the per-call payment round trip. With an Authorization: Bearer bby_live_... header on this connection it recharges that key. Without one, the paying wallet becomes the account and a new API key is minted and

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fetch_data" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
